question: Does a bounded local 3x4 affine bilateral grid provide held-block representation capacity beyond both the parameter-matched global LUT and the closed BT0 multiplicative gain grid on paired FiveK controls?

research_basis.primary: Wu et al., InstantRetouch: Efficient and High-Fidelity Instruction-Guided Image Retouching with Bilateral Space, CVPR 2026
research_basis.historical_control: Gharbi et al., Deep Bilateral Learning for Real-Time Image Enhancement, TOG 2017
research_basis.borrowed_idea_only: full-resolution colour is produced by slicing a low-resolution bilateral grid of local affine transforms
research_basis.clean_room_difference: no paper code, weights, data, diffusion teacher, instruction model or learned grid predictor; target-informed development capacity only

population.row_selection: lexicographically first pair_id within each of the exact 24 development camera_model groups
population.role: paired digital-retouch representation-capacity control; not film or stock evidence

candidate.source_guidance: within-image stable midrank of linear-sRGB luminance
candidate.application: trilinear grid slicing followed by one analytical per-pixel dose along the local affine residual

branch_rules.all_gates_pass: retain representation capacity and separately freeze a source-only bounded predictor question
branch_rules.any_gate_fails: close this exact affine bilateral representation without grid, regularization, split, target, population, metric or threshold rescue
branch_rules.visual_review: forbidden in this target-informed development-only capacity leaf

claim_ceiling: development-only held-block capacity evidence for one explicit bounded local affine bilateral grid on paired FiveK digital-retouch controls; not a deployable predictor, film response, stock identity, calibration, preference or product result
